title: flowable_deploy_bundle input
description: Arguments of the MCP tool flowable_deploy_bundle: several files deployed as one process deployment (packed into a .bar archive).

files.description: The files of the deployment, e.g. one .bpmn20.xml plus the <formKey>.schema.json form schemas its user tasks reference.

name.description: Plain file name with extension .bpmn, .bpmn20.xml, .form or .json (no path).

content.description: File content as text, or base64 with contentEncoding "base64".

contentEncoding.description: Set to "base64" when content is base64-encoded.

deploymentName.description: Deployment name, shown in the deployment list.

deploymentSource.description: Optional free-text source marker stored on the deployment.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID). Omit to use the default engine connection.
